$comment: External release gates. Only change a status to "done" after the work was really performed, and link the evidence. tests/release.test.mjs refuses "done" without an evidence file that exists.

code-signing.description: Sign the Windows installer and executable (and the Linux packages, if offered); verify the signatures.

clean-machine-install.description: Install, open a sample project, upgrade and uninstall on clean Windows 10/11 and Ubuntu machines.

hardware-qualification.description: Run the Arduino upload, serial monitor and FPGA flows on named physical boards.

accessibility-audit.description: Manual audit with NVDA, VoiceOver and keyboard-only use beyond the automated axe checks.

expert-numerical-review.description: Independent review of the engines in validation/manifest.json using docs/expert-review-checklist.md.

licence-review.description: Human review of the native third-party notices and source offers.

classroom-pilot.description: A supervised pilot with students; see docs/governance/classroom-pilot-plan.md.
